item: R3 item 4: anisotropic synthetic test (post-hoc mechanism follow-up; written before any run)
question: Does the scorer-fit inflation Delta depend on WHERE (high- vs low-variance eigendirections) the group (slide) effect lives, at matched slide-identity probe accuracy, and does the direction differ by scorer?

data_generating_process.features: x = mu_g + e, e ~ N(0, Sigma); Sigma = U diag(lambda) U^T, U random orthogonal (seeded), lambda_i = i^-1 (i = 1..d), rescaled so trace(Sigma) = d
data_generating_process.group_effect: mu_g = sigma_b * U_S diag(sqrt(lambda_S)) z_g, z_g ~ N(0, I_k): slide offsets live only in the k eigendirections S, scaled by their own variances
data_generating_process.calibration: sigma_b chosen per (d, placement) by bisection so that the slide-identity probe balanced accuracy = 0.90 +/- 0.02 (mean over 5 calibration draws, seeds disjoint from run seeds); calibration uses only the probe, never Delta
data_generating_process.probe: same as item 3 / camp_slide_identity.py: 300 train + 100 test patches per slide (fresh draws), L2-normalise, StandardScaler, LogisticRegression(C=1, lbfgs, max_iter=2000), balanced accuracy, 30 slides (chance 1/30)
data_generating_process.ood: 9 OOD groups, x = mu_ood + e, mu_ood = delta * v, v random unit vector (seeded, fixed per d), no group offsets; delta fixed per d before the run so that the disjoint-fit exact-covariance Mahalanobis AUROC is ~0.85 with no group effect (pilot, sigma_b = 0)
data_generating_process.group_and_sample_counts: Camelyon shape (paper2fold_designs.py 'camelyon'): 30 training slides with the real per-slide size profile (2 slides > 50k, 28 log-spaced from 1,430, total 302,436), ID-eval per slide = 0.111 x train, 9 OOD groups over a 5x range; all sizes rescaled by one factor per n/d ratio (shape kept, min 1)

scorers.exact_maha: empirical covariance (MLE) precision; if n_fit <= d: ridge Sigma_hat + eps I, eps = 1e-3 * trace(Sigma_hat) / d
scorers.knn: crossfit_ood KNNScorer (L2-normalised, k = 50, distance to k-th NN)
scorers.vim: crossfit_ood ViMScorer residual-only (default dim: 512 for d = 768, 1000 for d = 2560)

replicates: 50 per (d, n/d, placement) cell, run seeds 0-49 (feature draws + fold partition); population (U, v) fixed per d
outputs: per cell x scorer: mean Delta, SE over replicates, mean AUROC seen/unseen; per (d, n/d) x scorer: D = Delta_high - Delta_low with 95% CI (paired over replicate seeds, t-interval); calibrated sigma_b and achieved probe accuracy

predictions.exact_maha: Delta_high ~= Delta_low (|D| <= 0.01 and the 95% CI of D inside [-0.02, 0.02])
predictions.lw_maha: in between: D_exact < D_lw < D_knn (point estimates)

decision_rule: kNN / ViM prediction holds in a (d, n/d) cell if the 95% CI of D excludes 0 in the predicted direction; exact-Maha holds if the equivalence condition above holds; LW holds if the point-estimate ordering holds. Reported per cell (4 cells per scorer) as hold / fail / inconclusive (CI includes 0). No retuning of k, spectrum, sigma_b target, delta or counts after seeing any Delta.
status: post-hoc (not in the original precommit); results reported whatever they are
